title: LAL Site SPXI Implementation Report (Phase 1.2)
creator: Lee Sharks (implementer)
description:
A Phase 1.2 SPXI implementation and conformance report for `livingarchitecturelab.org`, prepared against `EA-SPXI-WEB-01 v3.0`. At the April 28, 2026 snapshot, the report records 11 of 12 protocol checks passing and five of six self-test items passing.

Implemented elements include crawl and canonical controls, structured data, entity Q/A, disambiguation, server-rendered canonical summaries, Tier 3 kernels, Holographic Kernels, a three-layer provenance tether, Semantic Integrity Markers, and cross-surface alignment. The remaining item is empirical retrieval measurement: the initial Drowning Test, `γ` score, SIM survival rate, and scheduled re-test were deferred.
